description:
Claire Redfield is a college student who ventured into Raccoon City to find her brother, Chris.
She's one of the few survivors of the Raccoon City Incident—one of the deadliest pandemics in history.

lines.text:
First the G-Virus, now the NEO-Virus?
It never ends.

These Raptures are mechanical creatures, you say?
It's hard to believe something like that could be enemies of humanity.
If you see an infected, turn and run as fast as you can. A direct confrontation is only a last resort.

I learned how to shoot from my brother.
He's a cop... but I haven't seen him around lately.

Promise me something.
Even if I'm not around, don't leave that kid—Deipara—all alone.

I can't exactly go back to being just a college student.
That's why I'm fighting—to make sure no one else has to live through this.

I wonder if Leon and Sherry are okay...
I disappeared so suddenly. They must be worried.

You're not planning on leaving me here alone, are you?
I'm counting on you to come back here soon, you hear?

The weapon I'm using? I borrowed it from the police station.
I asked for permission, though. I didn't just take it.

Are there any herbs in the Ark's garden?
If there are, what color?

I saw the coolest motorcycle parked outside the cafe.
Who's the owner? I have so many questions for them.
My name's Claire. Claire Redfield. And you are?
This looks strong enough to blow those things to hell.
Wow, wanna see how strong I've gotten?
I've got some good news. I can be of greater help now.

Wait, seriously? You're really giving this to me?
Well... thank you. I appreciate it.

Hmm... I should give you something in return.
How about a Mr. Raccoon plushie?
What is it? You won't be embarrassed if I open it now, will you?
Don't worry. As long as I'm with you, nothing bad's gonna happen.
Even in a hellish place like this, there always seems to be good people like you.
Honestly... it's a shame, knowing I won't see you again when I go back.
Ehm... Is this... your way of asking me out?
Don't worry, I can take care of myself.
Let's go!
One hell of a night, huh?
We've got no other choice.
Let's give 'em hell.
Everyone ready?
Reloading.
One sec, I need you to take point for a moment.
I've gotta reload. Cover me.
I've got an idea. Trust me on this one!
This ends here!
Let's finish this in one shot!
Next!
They just keep coming...
Target down!
Damn it!
Ow!
Ah!
Run, while you still can!
Nice work. When I get back, I'm heading straight for the shower.
